task: Security lens over lane 3 (uncommitted working tree vs d90743b): the new `from` URL parameter, the compass (nearestAnchors/bearingOf), the free zoom-out (planZoomOut/galaxyFraming/commitZoomOut), and every DOM sink added to the HUD. Can a crafted ?from= cause unbounded work or a wrong-but-plausible coordinate; can any value reach the DOM as markup; can __ugb.zoomOut or a crafted depth escape the policy; can a hostile address hang the compass; did the diff weaken the lane-2 clock refusals or the root guard.
verdict: PASS, no findings. All five claims confirmed. (1) ?from= is bounded twice: parseAddress caps the string at 900 chars before splitting, the level count at 64 and each level at |x| <= 2,147,483,647; from is dropped on any parse issue and when it names the current address. placement is O(1) per call (hash over a <=900-char string, one RNG draw) and returns null/{0,0,0} for the root and galaxy depths, so a deep from cannot crash. (2) No DOM injection: every sink added in hud.ts assigns textContent/dataset/.title/.className as properties; a grep for innerHTML|outerHTML|insertAdjacentHTML|document.write|eval|setAttribute over all of src/ has zero matches. The invalid-from echo in the issues line is textContent and bounded to 900 chars (the too-long case is echo-free). Click handlers close over Address objects, never strings read back from the DOM. (3) The zoom-out policy holds: only integer depth === GALAXY_DEPTH with levels.length >= 2 passes, and galaxyFrame then does O(1) work. pushState/replaceState exist only in writeUrl and are fed only by urlForState (URLSearchParams-encoded). (4) No hang: nearestAnchors is one pass with K=3 over the tier-budgeted galaxy.stars; compassEntries calls placement at most twice (origin and pin). (5) The diff does not touch advanceClock's 1e20 cap or four-digit ISO floor, and galaxy.ts (the root guard) is unmodified.
notes: Tests were run for real in the audit session: 23 files, 255 tests, 255 passed, 0 failed. New coverage includes every planZoomOut refusal (root, already-here, finer level, negative, non-integer), from drop/reject/round-trip, and the property that a camera gesture cannot grow history. No secret, credential, absolute path or personal data in the diff; the probe binds 127.0.0.1 only and window.__ugb exposes state, not credentials. No external content is read, so no prompt-injection surface; URL params are validated data. OWASP DOM-Based XSS Prevention Cheat Sheet Rules 6-7 (textContent as a safe sink), checked 2026-11-24, complies. The auditor reviewed tools/compass-probe.mjs statically (it had already been run by the chair, 20/20) and widened its read to address.ts, disc.ts, placement.ts and galaxy.ts only to answer the named questions. Cost: cents, one seat, one pass.
